info.title: LoL Builds API
info.description: REST API for creating and discussing League of Legends champion builds. Resources form the hierarchy Champion -> Build -> Comment. Lists support paging (page, pageSize) and filters; every resource has hypermedia links. Log in with POST /api/v1/auth/login (e.g. faker_fan / Password123!, or admin / Password123!) and send the access token as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.
